// Check the error reported by uvm_hdl_read and uvm_hdl_deposit when the
// object in the design has another value type than the access.

#include <systemc>
#include <uvm>

#include "reg.h"

using namespace std;
using namespace uvm;
using namespace sc_core;
using namespace sc_dt;

class dut_t : public sc_module
{
public:
  sc_signal<sc_uint<8>, SC_MANY_WRITERS> w;
  reg<sc_uint<8> > q;
  sc_vector<sc_signal<sc_uint<8>, SC_MANY_WRITERS> > v;

  dut_t(sc_module_name nm)
  : sc_module(nm), w("w"), q("q"), v("v", 2)
  {}
}; // class dut_t

class hdl_catcher : public uvm_report_catcher
{
public:
  static int seen;
  static std::string last_id;
  static std::string last_msg;

  virtual action_e do_catch()
  {
    if (get_severity() != UVM_ERROR)
      return THROW;
    seen++;
    last_id = get_id();
    last_msg = get_message();
    std::cout << "Caught [" << last_id << "] " << last_msg << std::endl;
    return CAUGHT;
  }
};

int hdl_catcher::seen = 0;
std::string hdl_catcher::last_id;
std::string hdl_catcher::last_msg;

class test : public uvm_test
{
public:
  UVM_COMPONENT_UTILS(test);

  test( uvm_component_name name ) : uvm_test(name), pass(true)
  {}

  static std::string expected( const std::string& path, const std::string& kind, int nbits )
  {
    std::ostringstream str;
    str << "Object " << path << " (" << kind << ") cannot be accessed: "
        << "it is not a uvm_sc_if<T> or an sc_signal<T, SC_MANY_WRITERS>, or an sc_vector of them, "
        << "with exactly the value type T of the access, a type of " << nbits << " bits "
        << "(register and memory backdoor accesses use uvm_reg_data_t).";
    return str.str();
  }

  void check( bool ok, const std::string& id, const std::string& msg )
  {
    if (ok)
    {
      std::cout << "ERROR: access unexpectedly succeeded" << std::endl;
      pass = false;
    }
    if (hdl_catcher::last_id != id || hdl_catcher::last_msg != msg)
    {
      std::cout << "ERROR: expected [" << id << "] " << msg << std::endl;
      pass = false;
    }
    hdl_catcher::last_id.clear();
    hdl_catcher::last_msg.clear();
  }

  void run_phase( uvm_phase& phase )
  {
    hdl_catcher ctchr;
    uvm_report_cb::add(nullptr, &ctchr);

    phase.raise_objection(this);

    sc_uint<16> val16 = 0x1234;

    check(uvm_hdl_read("dut.q", val16), "HDL_READ", expected("dut.q", "sc_object", 16));
    check(uvm_hdl_deposit("dut.q", val16), "HDL_DEPOSIT", expected("dut.q", "sc_object", 16));

    check(uvm_hdl_read("$root.dut.w", val16), "HDL_READ", expected("dut.w", "sc_signal", 16));
    check(uvm_hdl_deposit("dut.w", val16), "HDL_DEPOSIT", expected("dut.w", "sc_signal", 16));

    check(uvm_hdl_read("dut.v[1]", val16), "HDL_READ", expected("dut.v", "sc_vector", 16));
    check(uvm_hdl_deposit("dut.v[1]", val16), "HDL_DEPOSIT", expected("dut.v", "sc_vector", 16));

    uvm_reg_data_t data = 0;
    std::ostringstream nbits;
    check(uvm_hdl_read("dut.q", data), "HDL_READ", expected("dut.q", "sc_object", data.length()));

    // out-of-range vector index on read is reported with id HDL_READ
    sc_uint<8> val8 = 0;
    if (uvm_hdl_read("dut.v[5]", val8) || hdl_catcher::last_id != "HDL_READ")
    {
      std::cout << "ERROR: out-of-range read not reported with HDL_READ" << std::endl;
      pass = false;
    }

    if (hdl_catcher::seen != 8)
    {
      std::cout << "ERROR: expected 8 errors, caught " << hdl_catcher::seen << std::endl;
      pass = false;
    }

    phase.drop_objection(this);
    uvm_report_cb::do_delete(nullptr, &ctchr);
  }

  virtual void report_phase( uvm_phase& phase )
  {
    if (pass) std::cout << "** UVM TEST PASSED **" << std::endl;
    else std::cout << "!! UVM TEST FAILED !!" << std::endl;
  }

private:
  bool pass;
};

int sc_main(int, char*[])
{
  test test1("test1");
  dut_t dut("dut");

  run_test();

  return 0;
}
